title: Migrate from Jira Service Management to Unthread: Step-by-Step Jira Service Management Migration Guide
summary: Switch from Jira Service Management to Unthread with this step-by-step guide covering setup, data transfer, and integrations.
body_markdown:
Your employees are already asking for IT help in Slack. They message HR questions in channels. They ping finance for approvals in DMs. The question is whether those requests get tracked, routed, and resolved, or whether they disappear into the void of unstructured communication.


Jira Service Management works well for organizations committed to portal-based ITSM with formal ITIL processes. But for Slack-first teams, requiring employees to leave their primary workspace and navigate an external portal creates friction that reduces adoption. The result is shadow ticketing: employees asking questions in Slack that never get tracked, SLAs that cannot be enforced, and requests that fall through the cracks.


This is where[Slack-native ticketing](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) changes the equation. Unthread transforms channels like #it-help into complete internal help desks, automatically converting Slack conversations into structured tickets while preserving the natural chat experience employees prefer. No portal logins. No context switching. Just employees asking questions the way they already do, with full ticketing, routing, and automation happening behind the scenes.


## **Key Takeaways**


- **Portal-based ticketing creates friction that kills employee adoption.** Employees already ask IT and HR questions in Slack. Forcing them into external portals means lost tickets, delayed responses, and frustrated teams. Slack-native ticketing meets employees where they already work.
- **Migration complexity depends on your approach.** Professional migration services complete the transition in[1-5 business days](https://clonepartner.com/migrate/jira-service-management-to-unthread?ref=unthread.io) , while DIY migrations with 10,000+ tickets can take 2-4 weeks. Bidirectional sync offers a lower-risk path for teams not ready to fully retire JSM.
- **Purpose-built AI agents deliver measurable efficiency gains.** Lemonade achieves[40% automation](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) across IT, HR, Legal, Procurement, and Finance using Unthread's agentic AI, freeing agents to focus on complex issues requiring human expertise.
- **Configuration overhead drops dramatically with conversational ticketing.** Unthread deploys in[days versus weeks](https://unthread.io/blog/jsm-vs-freshservice-vs-unthread) required for JSM implementation, with simpler ongoing administration and faster workflow adjustments as needs evolve.
- **Multi-department consolidation eliminates tool sprawl.** A single platform serves IT, HR, Finance, Legal, and Procurement teams through one interface, replacing fragmented tools with unified analytics and consistent employee experiences.


## **Understanding the Shift: Why Modern IT Service Management Demands a New Approach**


Traditional ITSM platforms were built for a different era. Employees submitted tickets through web portals, waited for email notifications, and tracked progress in systems disconnected from their daily work. This model made sense when email was the primary communication tool and dedicated IT departments managed all technology requests.


Modern workplaces operate differently. Communication happens in real-time through Slack and Teams. Employees expect immediate responses, not 24-hour SLA acknowledgments. Support requests span IT, HR, Finance, Legal, and Procurement, not just technical issues. The traditional portal model creates friction at every step.


**Challenges with traditional ITSM platforms for Slack-first organizations:**


- **Context switching reduces productivity.** Agents must check external portals separately from their primary workspace, adding overhead to every interaction
- **Employee adoption suffers.** When submitting a ticket requires leaving Slack, employees often skip formal channels entirely
- **Manual ticket creation wastes time.** IT teams spend significant time copying information from Slack conversations into JSM
- **Conversational context gets lost.** Portal-based tickets lack the natural back-and-forth that resolves issues faster


The operational reality is straightforward: employees will use whatever path creates the least friction. If that path bypasses the ticketing system, organizations lose visibility into request volume, cannot enforce SLAs, and cannot measure team performance accurately.


## **Unthread's Conversational Advantage: Elevating Your Help Desk Software Experience**


Conversational ticketing eliminates the gap between how employees communicate and how tickets get tracked. When someone messages #it-help asking about VPN issues, Unthread automatically creates a ticket, applies SLAs, and routes to the appropriate agent. The employee continues chatting in Slack while the backend manages assignments, escalations, and resolution tracking.


This approach delivers high employee participation compared to typical portal adoption rates. Employees submit requests because submitting a request feels identical to sending a message, which they already do dozens of times daily.


**How Slack-native support transforms user interaction:**


- **Automatic ticket creation.** Every Slack thread in designated channels becomes a trackable ticket without manual data entry
- **In-channel resolution.** Agents respond directly in Slack threads, maintaining conversational flow while updating ticket status
- **Private ticketing flows.** Sensitive requests move to DMs automatically, keeping confidential HR issues out of public channels
- **Unified inbox.** Agents view all open tickets from Slack without opening external dashboards


The[IT service desk](https://unthread.io/solutions/it-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) benefits extend beyond convenience. When every request gets tracked automatically, IT leaders gain accurate visibility into request volume, common issues, and team performance. SLA compliance becomes enforceable because nothing slips through the cracks.


## **The Role of AI in Your New Service Desk Tool**


Purpose-built AI agents represent the most significant efficiency opportunity in modern service management. Unlike traditional automation that follows rigid rules, agentic AI understands request intent, queries knowledge bases, and resolves routine issues without human intervention.


Lemonade deployed Unthread's[agentic AI](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) across IT, HR, Legal, Procurement, and Finance departments. The results demonstrate what autonomous resolution looks like at scale:[40% automation](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) of all incoming tickets. This is not just access request automation. The AI handles diverse workflows across multiple departments, from benefits questions to software provisioning to policy clarifications.


**What distinguishes agentic AI from traditional automation:**


- **Intent understanding.** Natural language processing identifies what employees actually need, not just keyword matches
- **Knowledge base integration.** AI queries documentation to provide accurate answers, citing sources for verification
- **Workflow execution.** Automated actions like creating Jira issues, updating HRIS records, or triggering approval chains
- **Intelligent escalation.** Complex requests route to human agents with full context preserved


The self-learning[knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) amplifies these capabilities over time. Unthread automatically detects repeat questions from ticket patterns and generates draft help articles for team review. When documentation gaps cause repeated escalations, the system flags outdated content and suggests updates. This continuous improvement loop means AI resolution rates increase as knowledge bases mature.


Bring-your-own-LLM functionality through MCP integration allows organizations to use internal AI instances rather than external providers. This addresses data sovereignty concerns while enabling customization for specific terminology, policies, and workflows unique to each organization.


## **Streamlining Operations: Migrating Your Jira Service Management Ticketing System**


Most organizations do not need to fully replace JSM to gain Slack-native benefits. Bidirectional sync provides a lower-risk path: keep JSM as the system of record while adding Unthread as the Slack-native front end. Employees interact through Slack, tickets sync to JSM, and existing ITIL workflows continue unchanged.


### **Bidirectional Sync Setup (Recommended for Most Teams)**


The[integration process](https://docs.unthread.io/docs/jira-service-management-jsm?ref=unthread.io) involves connecting JSM instances through OAuth authorization and configuring relay rules mapping Unthread conversations to JSM request types. New matching conversations automatically create Jira issues with synchronized status, priority, assignee, and comments.


Conflict handling uses a 3-way sync model. If both systems change the same field simultaneously, Unthread wins and syncs the value back to JSM, ensuring data consistency.


### **Full Migration Considerations**


For organizations retiring JSM entirely,[professional migration services](https://clonepartner.com/migrate/jira-service-management-to-unthread?ref=unthread.io) complete the transition in 1-5 business days. DIY migrations require significant engineering effort: 40-160 hours for data extraction, identity resolution, and custom field mapping depending on volume and complexity.


Key technical challenges include:


- **Identity resolution.** Mapping JSM email addresses to Slack user IDs requires querying Slack APIs for every unique user
- **Attachment re-hosting.** JSM file URLs must be downloaded and re-uploaded to Slack storage
- **Workflow rebuilds.** Automations do not transfer between platforms. Document top JSM automations and recreate them using Unthread's[automation builder](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io)
- **SLA configuration.** Import historical tickets only after configuring SLA exclusions to prevent false breach alerts


## **Enhancing Employee Experience Across Departments**


Internal support extends far beyond IT. HR teams field benefits questions, parental leave requests, and policy clarifications. Finance handles expense approvals and budget inquiries. Legal reviews contracts and compliance questions. Procurement manages vendor requests and purchase orders.


Traditional approaches require separate tools for each department or force-fitting all requests into IT-centric workflows. Neither approach serves employees well. Unthread's multi-department architecture provides a single platform with department-specific configurations, SLAs, and routing rules.


### **Private Ticketing for Sensitive HR Requests**


[HR service desk](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) workflows often involve confidential information: payroll errors, harassment reports, medical accommodations, termination questions. Public Slack channels cannot handle these appropriately.


Unthread's private ticketing flows address this directly. Employees submit sensitive requests via DM to the HR bot. Tickets move automatically to private threads where HR staff collaborate internally without exposing confidential details. The employee receives updates through private messages while HR maintains full audit trails.


### **Multi-Department Consolidation Benefits**


- **Unified analytics.** Executives see IT, HR, Finance, Legal, and Procurement metrics in one dashboard
- **Consistent employee experience.** Same interface regardless of request type
- **Reduced tool sprawl.** Replace fragmented point solutions with a single platform
- **Cross-department visibility.** Requests requiring multiple teams route appropriately with shared context


This approach can lead to[significant efficiency gains](https://unthread.io/blog/jsm-vs-freshservice-vs-unthread) by eliminating duplicate systems and standardizing workflows across departments.


## **Post-Migration Success: Optimizing Your Help Desk with Analytics**


Migration completion marks the beginning, not the end.[AI analytics](https://unthread.io/products/analytics?ref=unthread.io) provide real-time visibility into support operations, enabling continuous optimization based on actual performance data rather than assumptions.


**Key metrics to track post-migration:**


- **AI deflection rate.** Percentage of issues resolved by knowledge base or automations before human intervention
- **SLA compliance.** Response and resolution time performance against defined targets
- **Volume trends.** Request patterns by department, category, and time period
- **Team performance.** Individual and team metrics for workload distribution and capacity planning
- **CSAT and NPS.** Employee satisfaction with support experiences


Custom dashboards surface the metrics that matter for each organization. Export capabilities to BI tools like Looker, Tableau, or Hex via raw data API enable deeper analysis and integration with broader operational reporting.


The self-learning knowledge base uses these analytics to identify improvement opportunities automatically. When ticket patterns indicate documentation gaps, the system generates draft articles addressing common questions. When existing content becomes outdated, it flags articles needing review with clear before/after change recommendations.


## **Ensuring Security and Scalability: Enterprise-Grade Migration Considerations**


Enterprise migrations require confidence in security, compliance, and scalability. Unthread maintains[SOC2 compliance](https://unthread.io/security?ref=unthread.io) with regular independent security audits and penetration testing. HIPAA compliance with Business Associate Agreements supports healthcare organizations handling protected health information.


**Security and compliance capabilities:**


- **Encryption.** TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest for all credentials and ticket data
- **Access controls.** Role-based permissions with SSO integration on Enterprise plans
- **Data privacy.** Policy of not training AI models on customer data, with bring-your-own-LLM options
- **Enterprise deployment.** Slack Enterprise Grid support, isolated hosted environments, SCIM sync for automated user provisioning


For organizations with strict data residency requirements, dedicated hosting options provide isolated environments with regional deployment flexibility.


**Scalability considerations:**


[Unthread pricing](https://unthread.io/pricing?ref=unthread.io) scales predictably: $50/agent/month for Basic (100 conversations/month cap), $75/agent/month for Pro (unlimited conversations), and custom Enterprise pricing for advanced requirements. The Pro tier includes unlimited AI usage with no overage fees.


## **Your Migration Checklist: A Step-by-Step Guide to Unthread Adoption**


Successful migrations follow a structured approach. Whether choosing bidirectional sync or full migration, this checklist ensures nothing gets missed.


### **Phase 1: Preparation and Planning (3-5 days)**


- Audit current JSM configuration: issue types, custom fields, workflows, automations
- Document top 10 highest-volume automations for recreation in Unthread
- Establish record count baselines for validation
- Build Slack User ID to email mapping table if pursuing full migration
- Decide: bidirectional sync (recommended) or full migration


### **Phase 2: Configuration and Testing (2-5 days)**


- Connect JSM integration and configure relay rules
- Set up department-specific projects with appropriate SLAs and routing
- Import knowledge base content from existing documentation sources
- Configure private ticketing flows for sensitive HR requests
- Run test migration with sample tickets and validate field mappings


### **Phase 3: Launch and Optimization (ongoing)**


- Enable Unthread in pilot channels with limited agent group
- Monitor AI deflection rates and knowledge base performance
- Gather agent feedback and adjust configurations
- Expand to additional departments after pilot validation
- Review analytics weekly and optimize based on actual performance


Dedicated solutions engineers on[Enterprise plans](https://unthread.io/pricing?ref=unthread.io) assist with configuration and onboarding. Enterprise customers receive enhanced support with implementation teams and custom SLAs.


For teams ready to eliminate portal friction and meet employees where they work,[schedule a demo](https://unthread.io/demo?ref=unthread.io) to see conversational ticketing in action.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **How does Unthread handle Microsoft Teams environments alongside Slack?**


Unthread supports multi-channel intake including Microsoft Teams, Discord, Telegram, and WhatsApp in addition to Slack. Organizations using both Slack and Teams can configure intake from either platform while maintaining unified ticketing and analytics. The conversational ticketing model works similarly across platforms: messages become tickets automatically with routing, SLAs, and AI resolution functioning consistently regardless of source channel.


### **What happens to JSM Marketplace apps and custom integrations during migration?**


Marketplace apps and custom integrations do not migrate automatically. Evaluate each integration's function and determine the Unthread equivalent. Many common integrations have native Unthread connectors (Salesforce, HubSpot, Okta, Workday, GitHub). For custom integrations, Unthread's REST API and webhook system enable similar functionality. Plan to rebuild critical integrations during the configuration phase rather than expecting automatic transfer.


### **Can we run Unthread and JSM simultaneously during a transition period?**


Yes, parallel running is the recommended approach. Configure bidirectional sync so tickets flow between systems, keeping JSM in read-only mode as a fallback. This approach lets teams validate Unthread's functionality with live data while maintaining the ability to revert if issues arise. Most organizations run parallel systems for 2-4 weeks before fully transitioning to Unthread as the primary interface.


### **How does Unthread handle on-call rotations and after-hours escalations?**


Unthread includes on-call rotation management with workload distribution based on availability and expertise. Configure escalation rules that route tickets to on-call agents outside business hours, with automatic escalation to backup agents if response thresholds are not met. Integration with alerting tools enables incident management workflows where critical issues page appropriate team members regardless of time.


### **What training do agents need to use Unthread effectively?**


Agent training requirements are minimal because Unthread operates within Slack, which most teams already use daily. Typical training sessions run 1-2 hours covering ticket management workflows, AI agent interaction, and reporting dashboards. Compare this to JSM implementations that often require 8-16 hours of training per agent due to the separate portal interface and ITSM-specific concepts. The Slack-native design means agents work in a familiar environment from day one.
